title: UK CPI, January 2027 (ONS, 07:00 London) — the annual basket reweight, and the print that finally sizes both electricity-VAT base effects
source: EST: ons.gov.uk/releases/consumerpriceinflationukjanuary2027, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200) — the release page reads 'Consumer price inflation, UK: January 2027', 'Release date: 17 February 2027 7:00am', and states 'This release is not yet published'; ONS labels the entry Provisional. Filed estimate on that label, on this lane's no-self-confirm limit, and on the standing taxonomy gap (market-events-data.ts has no confirmed prefix for the UK Office for National Statistics). Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of uk-cpi-2027-11-17, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED BY THE uk-cpi-2027-11-17 LANE, 2026-09-09. This is the January print, which is where ONS publishes the new annual CPI weights — and it is the SIZING VENUE for both electricity-VAT base effects the SI 2026/987 window creates (the drag dropping out on 2027-05-19, and the upward step on 2027-11-17). Until it prints, both steps are a range and not a number: headline effect = 2027 CJXA weight x 5.0%, and the 2027 weight is undrawn. CJXA fetched direct 2026-09-09 reads 27.0 (2023), 23.3142 (2024), 19.1488 (2025), 20.6065 (2026) per 1000. THE MECHANISM THAT MAKES THIS PRINT WORTH DIARISING RATHER THAN JUST READING: ONS price-updates each year's weights to DECEMBER OF THE PRIOR YEAR (CPI technical manual, fetched: 'The weight for January is calculated by price updating the expenditure (V) in the weight reference period to the December of the previous year'), and December 2026 sits INSIDE the zero-rate window — so the 2027 electricity weight is price-updated through a VAT-free price and comes in about 4.76% below its counterfactual. The tax cut mechanically shrinks the weight that scales its own reversal. Registered as FT-uk-cpi-2027-11-17-3 (prediction: 2027 CJXA lands 18.0-21.5 per 1000, tightening the October 2027 headline VAT contribution to +0.090 to +0.108pp), score by 2027-02-17. The January print is also the annual basket update, so it carries item churn beyond energy. Tiered LOW: symbols: [], no UK listing, gilt or sterling instrument on this calendar. Estimate widens caution only.
